remarks: Beautifully renovated 5-bedroom, 2-bathrooms home offering modern comfort and turnkey living. Step inside to be greeted by an open layout, Gleaming Hardwood Floors and a stunning Custom-New Kitchen. Sun-drenched living room with stylish fireplace. The upper level, which offers Four Bedrooms and Two Full Bathrooms, is highlighted by a Private Ensuite in the primary bedroom with a full bath and large walk-in closet. Step up to the attic where you will find the fifth bedroom and half bath. An oversized Patio, perfect for entertaining while looking at the Peaceful Backyard. This house is gutted to the studs with new drywall, fresh paint throughout, modern trim, modern shaker style door, New vinyl siding, new windows. New electrical, plumbing, and heating system. Natural gas for heating and cooking. Central AC. This is a must-see to fully appreciate the exceptional craftsmanship and thoughtful design throughout this move-in ready home!
